source.title: Bas-relief scan, seated figure writing and a winged figure at a stele

rights.statement: Supplied by the House Adel project owner as a 148 MB / 2,966,746-triangle binary STL, replacing an earlier scan of the same name on 2026-08-08. The originating scan, sculpture, photographer and licence have NOT been verified by this repository. Rights must be confirmed by the project owner before public launch.

original.notes: Binary STL, 2,966,746 triangles. Not shipped; kept outside the build. Re-bake with scripts/bake-relief-depth.mjs.

derivatives.transformation: Height baked from the STL onto a 2048x1619 grid by scripts/bake-relief-depth.mjs: carved axis and depth polarity detected from the geometry, cropped to where the surface samples densely, holes closed by neighbour dilation, despeckled with a 3px median. Encodes height only; no colour from the source exists.

Height baked from the STL onto a 1024x809 grid by scripts/bake-relief-depth.mjs: carved axis and depth polarity detected from the geometry, cropped to where the surface samples densely, holes closed by neighbour dilation, despeckled with a 3px median. Encodes height only; no colour from the source exists.

transformations: The scan is a bas-relief: its shallow axis spans only 11.3% of its width, so it is fully described by one height per point.
Baking replaces a 143 MB mesh with a 207 KB height map, a reduction of roughly 700x, with no geometry shipped.
No crop, colour grade, retouch or generative fill. Height values only.
